contract.bindings: Inputs retain positional order. Prediction references use input index or 8 + declaration slot; word references/declarations use sequential bN indices. Recipe expansion introduces additional charged lexical bindings.
contract.compatibility: Prediction conversion accepts base-v2 only. Vector operations, resource ownership and runtime schema are not lowered or relabeled.
contract.constants: Integers preserve signed 128-bit magnitude bounds. Prediction magnitude bits are LSB-first; stream magnitude words are canonical MSB-first. Booleans remain distinct from integers.
not_measured: human navigation, corrections and completion time

prediction_mapping.conversion: prediction padding only; not a stream word

contract.structure: first-child/next-sibling links become charged prefix grammar, block counts and argument counts; no edge table is required by the resulting packet
contract.types: Prediction type IDs are fitted side information. Stream types and compound arity are explicit words; no fitted type table is required to decode the packet.

evidence_scope: Five authored fixtures at three widths. Predictor codes are supplied perfect graph encodings, not model predictions. No protected/source evaluation, native qualification, human measurement or solver result.
